newsitem.title: USA: Fed cancels add operations, repeats them later.
newsitem.headline: Fed cancels add operations, repeats them later.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York cancelled the overnight and the 14-day fixed system repurchase agreements it had carried out earlier on Thursday due to technical problems, a Fed spokesman said.

The central bank, however, repeated the two add operations shortly after the technical glitch was fixed, the spokesman added. The Fed official had anticipated earlier the central bank was likely to repeat the add operations.

At 1201 EDT/1601 GMT, the time when the Fed intervened in the market for the second time, the federal funds rate was quoted at 5-5/16 percent, above the central bank's 5-1/4 percent target for the rate.
The cancellation was due to technical factors and had no implication on the Fed's monetary policy, analysts said.
